diagnostics.message: The Splunk AWS integration is enabled with metric-stream synchronization but does not wait for the inline role policy granting CloudWatch metric-stream and iam:PassRole permissions to be attached. The delay after role creation does not establish ordering on this policy attachment.

The Splunk AWS integration can be created before the inline role policy granting its AWS inventory and data-collection permissions is attached. Add an ordering dependency so the remote integration is not provisioned before this policy.
